definition: Robert Tibshirani (born July 10, 1956) is a professor in the Departments of Statistics and Biomedical Data Science at Stanford University.
details: Introduced L1 regularization (LASSO) for feature selection and shrinkage, and co-wrote foundational statistical learning textbooks. He was a professor at the University of Toronto from 1985 to 1998. In his work, he develops statistical tools for the analysis of complex datasets, most recently in genomics and proteomics. His most well-known contributions are the Lasso method, which proposed the use of L1 penalization in regression and related problems, and Significance Analysis of Microarrays.

explainer.lead: Robert Tibshirani is a Canadian statistician. His work spans statistics.

timeline.what: Tibshirani was born on 10 July 1956 in Niagara Falls, Ontario, Canada.
He received his B. Math. in statistics and computer science from the University of Waterloo in 1979 and a Master's degree in Statistics from the University of Toronto in 1980.
Tibshirani joined the doctoral program at Stanford University in 1981 and received his Ph.D. in 1984 under the supervision of Bradley Efron.
Named Fellow of the Institute of Mathematical Statistics
Named Fellow of the Royal Society
